recognize_zh: 脂肪細胞之間有一條細長管道，管壁有扁長的內皮細胞核，管腔內排列多顆紅血球，這就是骨髓中的微血管（capillary），屬正常結構。
features: Narrow vascular channel running between adipocytes
Flattened, elongated endothelial nuclei lining the channel
Luminal red blood cells, several with crescent or fixation-distorted shapes
Thin eosinophilic cytoplasmic/stromal septa surrounding large empty fat vacuoles
No hematopoietic cells or inflammatory infiltrate in this field
describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow section (H&E) shows a thin-walled capillary coursing between adipocytes. The channel is lined by flattened, elongated endothelial nuclei and contains a row of intraluminal red blood cells, some showing crescentic fixation artifact. The surrounding fat cells and delicate stromal septa are unremarkable, and no hematopoietic or inflammatory cells are present in the field. Findings represent a normal marrow capillary.

ddx.vs: Erythrophagocytosis shows red cells within a macrophage cytoplasm around a single oval macrophage nucleus, not within a lumen lined by flattened endothelial cells.
Yeasts are smaller, uniform, with a clear halo or capsule and a nuclear dot, whereas these have the size and hemoglobin color of red cells.
